convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'Trigger_Line' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, requiring reverse-engineering or recreation of the custom indicator logic for Python conversion

other_exits: Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new position

custom_logic_notes: EA relies on custom 'Trigger_Line' indicator which is a compiled .ex5 file; the indicator logic is opaque and must be reverse-engineered or sourced separately. The EA reads two buffers from the custom indicator and uses their crossover/crossunder for signal generation. Signal reversal triggers closing existing opposite position before opening a new one.
python_conversion_notes: The custom Trigger_Line indicator logic must be recreated in Python. Without access to the indicator source code, the conversion requires either decompiling/reverse-engineering the .ex5 indicator or finding the original Trigger_Line indicator specification. The EA framework itself is simple (crossover entry, fixed SL/TP, new-bar guard), but the dependency on an unknown custom indicator makes this manual-convert. Once the indicator logic is known, Python implementation is straightforward using numpy/pandas for the indicator and signal generation.
